search_web.description: Search the web with DuckDuckGo and get an instant answer: a topic summary, a direct answer or definition when one exists, and a list of related links. No API key required.

mock_response.abstract: DuckDuckGo is an internet search engine that emphasizes protecting searchers' privacy.
mock_response.heading: DuckDuckGo

related_topics.text: Search engine - a software system for finding information.

search_web.name: search_web

parameters.description: When on, a query that starts with a DuckDuckGo !bang (like '!w cats') returns instant-answer data instead of redirecting to the external site. On by default.
parameters.name: no_redirect

parameters.description: When on, an ambiguous term returns its most likely single meaning instead of a list of possible meanings. On by default.
parameters.name: skip_disambig

abstract.description: A short summary of the topic.

abstract_source.description: Where the summary came from (e.g. Wikipedia).

abstract_url.description: A link to the summary's source page.

answer.description: A direct answer (e.g. for a calculation), if any.

definition.description: A dictionary definition of the term, if any.

definition_url.description: A link to the definition's source.

heading.description: The title of the matched topic, if any.

image.description: An image URL for the topic, if any.

related_topics.description: Related links, each with text, url, and icon.

response_type.description: DuckDuckGo's answer category: A=article, D=disambiguation, C=category, N=name, E=exclusive, or empty when there is no instant answer.

result_count.description: How many related topics were returned.

results.description: The topic's official site links, if any.

description: Search the web with DuckDuckGo's Instant Answer API: topic summaries, direct answers, definitions, and related links.
